O+ Connect Now Available for macOS

O+ Connect for macOS offers  Multi-Screen Connect, Remote Control, and Sticky Notes, supporting both Intel and Apple chip architectures.

With this app, users can seamlessly view, edit, and manage all files on their phones directly from their computers, enabling effortless two-way file sharing. It also allows users to quickly record notes or to-do lists, with real-time synchronization across devices for easy access and editing. Additionally, you can remotely control your computer from your phone anytime, anywhere.

Currently, these features are exclusively available on the OPPO Find N5, with plans to expand support to other models in the future.

To use O+ Connect, phones must be updated to ColorOS 15.0.1 or realme UI 6.0 and above, while Mac computers require macOS 10.14 or later.

O+ Connect for Windows is coming soon. In the meantime, Windows users can continue using the Multi-Screen Connect app or Phone Link (Link to Windows).
